v2Frames.constraint: Reachable from idle and walk; no VFX.
Readable compression without making a Light feel heavy.
Only visible impact; lead arm and planted base remain continuous.
Continue the same shoulder and fist path with no second hit.
Bend and retract the same elbow while coat and locs continue their lag.
Return toward neutral with residual momentum; do not duplicate idle.

benchmarkQuestions: Does frame 01 expose intent without making the Light sluggish?
Does frame 01 to frame 02 snap quickly as one lead-arm straight?
Is frame 02 the only visible contact?
Do frames 03-05 read as overshoot, recoil and connected recovery rather than a second punch?
Does the clip enter from and return toward Lamuh neutral without scale pumping or root drift?

supersededTimingCandidates.reason: Superseded on 2026-09-03 by a gameplay-reconciliation pass. The approved candidates were authored against a 1-tick active window that does not exist in src/data/fighters.ts, so candidate B was longer than the move it belongs to. The build therefore emitted a truncated runtime timeline that dropped authored frames and placed the contact pose outside the live hitbox window. The replacement candidates keep the same authored frames, roles and impact frame, and only redistribute exposure so that candidate B equals the combat frame data exactly.
